idea-plugin.name: JSP Jump
idea-plugin.description:
Click a button, input or grid column on a page served by your local server (Tomcat etc.) in the browser and the IDE opens the JSP line that defines it — like the browser's Inspect element picker, but it jumps to your source code.

Getting started

  1. When JSP Jump is installed, the bookmark page (http://localhost:63342/jspjump/install) opens in your browser together with an IDE notification. You can open the page again with Tools | JSP Jump: Add Browser Bookmark....
  2. Show the bookmarks bar (Ctrl+Shift+B) and drag the JSP Jump button onto it. This is needed once per browser: a page can only be inspected by a script running in it.
  3. Open your page on the local server, click the bookmark, then click an element.

How it works

  1. On your local page, click the bookmarklet: jump mode turns on and the element under the mouse is highlighted (Esc cancels).
  2. Click once: the bookmarklet sends the element's clues (id, name, text, AUIGrid dataField, page URL) to the IDE's built-in server (http://localhost:63342/jspjump) and jump mode turns off. The click does not reach the page. When several JetBrains IDEs run, the built-in server port differs (63343, ...): the bookmarklet finds the right IDE on ports 63342–63361 automatically.
  3. The IDE searches the project's JSP files and opens the matching line. If there are several candidates, a popup lets you choose. The result is shown as a toast in the browser.

Matching

  • id attributes, including EL prefixes such as id=${prefix}field
  • name attributes
  • AUIGrid columns: .addColumnCustom("dataField", ...) and dataField: "..." (function names are configurable)
  • Button / label text, then the nearest ancestor with an id
  • JSP files named after the page URL or the screen root element are searched first, then the scripts they load with <script src> (grid columns defined in JS), then other JSPs and project scripts

Security

Everything stays on your machine. Requests are accepted only from the page origins configured in Settings | Tools | JSP Jump (default: localhost / 127.0.0.1, any port). A page served from a LAN address or dev host name triggers an IDE notification with an Allow button.

한국어

JSP Jump를 설치하면 북마크 추가 페이지가 브라우저에 자동으로 열리고 IDE에 안내 알림이 뜹니다. (다시 열기: Tools | JSP Jump: Add Browser Bookmark...) 그 페이지에서 북마크 버튼을 크롬 북마크바로 끌어다 놓으세요(브라우저당 한 번). IDE 포트(63342~63361)는 자동으로 찾습니다.

로컬 서버로 띄운 화면에서 북마클릿으로 점프 모드를 켜고 버튼·입력칸·AUIGrid 컬럼을 한 번 클릭하면, IDE가 그 요소를 정의한 JSP 파일의 해당 줄을 엽니다. 후보가 여러 개면 IDE에서 목록으로 고를 수 있고, 결과는 브라우저에 토스트로 표시됩니다. 허용 Origin·검색 경로·그리드 컬럼 함수명은 Settings | Tools | JSP Jump에서 바꿀 수 있습니다.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release: bookmarklet jump mode → open the JSP line in the IDE
  • Matching by id (with EL prefix), name, AUIGrid dataField / header text, element text and ancestor id
  • Candidate popup when several locations match
  • Settings: allowed origins, search globs, grid column function names
  • Setup: bookmark page and notification when the plugin is installed; page in Korean / English with connection test and troubleshooting; Tools menu entry
  • Automatic IDE port detection (63342–63361) and best-IDE selection when several IDEs run

action.description: Open the page that adds the JSP Jump bookmarklet to your browser
